name: route
description: A model-routing loop for Claude Code: the main thread plans, writes specs, and adjudicates; scout (haiku) maps the codebase and compresses logs; builder (sonnet) implements; reviewer (sonnet) checks risk work; scribe (haiku) records outcomes. Role boundaries are enforced by PreToolUse hooks, not prompt etiquette. Per-role model tiers are configurable per project via /route:config.
